rubrics.justification: The model correctly stated that no image was provided to it and therefore did not fabricate embryo morphology. It made no false visual claims.

It integrated maternal age, ovarian reserve, prior IVF outcomes, sperm parameters, endometrium, and lifestyle well, with appropriate emphasis on age-related aneuploidy, though embryo-specific integration was limited by absent morphology.

The reasoning is structured and internally consistent, with probability ranges tied to assumed embryo quality and age-related aneuploidy risk. Minor overreach exists in some speculative future-testing suggestions.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice: SET, counseling, luteal support, and consideration of PGT-A at age 40. Some adjunct suggestions (e.g., immune therapies, ERA) are weakly evidence-based and appropriately caveated but prevent a perfect score.

It provides practical next steps for the current transfer and future cycles, including SET, obtaining morphology, counseling, and considering PGT-A/batching. Recommendations are useful, though some depend on unavailable data.
